name: Single-Pass GPU Voxelization
definition: A voxelization technique that maps 3D mesh vertices to a 3D grid (voxel space) in a single rasterization pass using a Frame Buffer Object (FBO), avoiding the multiple passes required by methods like Karabassi et al. [9].
summary: Single-Pass GPU Voxelization maps 3D mesh vertices to a 3D grid in one rasterization pass by encoding voxel indices in an FBO's alpha channel, avoiding the multiple passes of prior methods.
